newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand endorses Finance One, Thai Danu merger.
newsitem.headline: Thailand endorses Finance One, Thai Danu merger.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said it endorsed Friday's merger between Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank Plc which will result in the formation a new bank, Thai Danu Bank.

"The new entity, with combined asets and liabilities of both financial institutions will be granted a new commercial banking licence and will operate under the name of Thai Danu Bank," the central bank said in a statement.

Finance One, Thailand's largest finance firm and medium-sized Thai Danu Bank announced their planned merger in early March. They are due to sign a memorandum of understanding for the merger at 0930 GMT.
"The merger will set a precedent for future consolidation among other financial institutions which will over time result in a stronger and more efficient financial system," the central bank said.
Analysts had predicted that the Finance One-Thai Danu merger would herald other such moves in Thailand's troubled finance sector.

Last week authorities ordered a shake-up of the financial sector by ordering 10 finance firms to raise capital. They also told all financial institutions to raise provisions for sub-standard loans, mainly lent to the depressed property sector.
The Bank of Thailand said it and the finance ministry would give full support for the merger and any other mergers between financial institutions that may take place in the future.
"If necessary, liquidity assistance will be provided by the Bank of Thailand's Financial Institutions Development Fund," it said.
"Likewise, the newly created Property Loan Management Organisation will be on hand to assist finncial institutions concerned to resolve their troubled property loans."
The finance ministry would also be prepared to clear any tax obstacles to facilitate any future mergers smoothly, it said.
